description: The conversation around one email: every email of the same application, or of the same sender and subject when it belongs to none, oldest first. Each message gives its id, sender, subject, received time, category and the application it belongs to, without bodies. Reads only.
name: get_thread

messages.description: Every email of the conversation, oldest first, without bodies.

items.description: One email of the inbox: who sent it, when, what it is and the application it belongs to.

application.description: The application this email belongs to, or null when it belongs to none.

job_id.description: The job id of the application.

category.description: What the email is, as classified: interview, rejection, assessment, offer, recruiter, verification, application_confirmation or unknown.

id.description: The message id get_message and get_thread take.

title: Read an email conversation
